title: Animal HUD
description: Animal HUD is a lightweight vanilla datapack that gives players a real time information overlay for any nearby passive animal they look at, making farming, breeding, taming, and managing animals much easier.
body:
**Animal HUD** is a lightweight vanilla quality of life datapack that displays useful information about the passive animal you're looking at.

Simply look at a supported animal within range and a clean action bar HUD will appear, showing details such as health, age, ownership, variants, saddles, wool color, bee status, and much more. The HUD updates in real time and disappears automatically when you look away.

Designed to feel like an official Minecraft feature, Animal HUD works entirely through a datapack with **no mods or resource packs required**.

## Features

• Real time action bar HUD

• Displays information only for the animal you're looking at

• Supports over 20 passive mobs

• Shows health, age, variants, ownership, saddles, wool color, bee status, and more

• Multiplayer compatible

• Vanilla friendly design

• Lightweight and optimized

• Works in survival

## Supported Versions

**Minecraft Java Edition 1.21+**

Primary support: **1.21.11**
